question: Do recovered final artifacts satisfy the complete original training-state contract before the next continuation or A003 numerical evaluation?
hypothesis: Independent CPU validation of final/full state, optimizer mapping, scheduler, RNG structure, metrics and lineage can reject incomplete or mismatched artifacts that a zero exit or final step field alone would accept.

sources.version: official tutorial read2026-11-15, applied to local2.12 source
sources.consequence: Require both model.pt and resumable checkpoint.pt; restore model/head, optimizer and scheduler without taking a training step, and compare final/full learned states exactly.

sources.sections: state, param_groups, ID/order matching without further verification
sources.consequence: Check IDs/group order against the reviewed input checkpoint and tensor moment shapes against pinned model parameters before optimizer loading. A load call alone is insufficient.

sources.sections: Scheduler initialization warning and parameter names
sources.consequence: Construct the scheduler before restoring optimizer state; preserve explicit original parameter order and verify the loaded state exactly.

sources.sections: get_last_lr, state_dict and nonserialized lambda functions
sources.consequence: Rebuild the original schedule function from pinned source; verify epoch, base rates and final rates against the recipe and optimizer.
Restore/check CPU RNG, inspect saved GPU RNG dtype/shape against the original input without initializing CUDA. This does not establish bitwise GPU continuation.

sources.sections: Process identity, is_running and zombie state
sources.consequence: Require terminal supervisor evidence and absent/nonlive exact child identity before reading final artifacts. Do not certify a live run as complete.

differences: This CPU-only artifact verifier implements the final-state gate already required by A014. It neither changes training nor replaces A003. Software fixtures deliberately synthesize final counters from preserved real schemas and are clearly labeled; they are not completed scientific runs.
contrary_evidence: Valid serialized states and finite logs do not prove useful representations, stable GPU inference or planning. Logged finite values do not cover every unlogged loss; optimizer counters provide an additional check of resumed updates. Preserved input counters may already be below the nominal input step and must be reported, not silently repaired.

protocol.scope: All six A014 continuations, and CPU fault-injection tests only. No GPU initialization, model forward/backward, optimizer update, signal, training fallback or source edit to original/gated worktrees.
protocol.custody: Bind to A014 plan/preparation/software and terminal execution/result digests. Verify original source/data/config hashes, immutable source checkpoint and exact run lineage; require exit0 and no live matching child. Copy final model/full checkpoint/config/metrics through open inodes into fresh audit directories, then verify source bytes remain unchanged.
protocol.state: Require full and final step303000, original kind/n/model/train config, no inference-only marker, finite numeric/tensor state, strict pinned model/head loading and exact equality of final/full model/head tensors. Restore CPU RNG exactly; GPU RNG must have input-matching byte dtype/shape only.
protocol.optimizer: Require group/parameter IDs and order identical to the immutable input; preserve group hyperparameters except scheduled lr. Require the same populated state IDs; check AdamW moment shapes/dtypes and finite scalar step counts. Each used state's final counter must equal its input counter plus303000-input_step. Report prior counter deficits explicitly. Construct original AdamW and LambdaLR, load states and verify exact restored dictionaries. No optimizer or scheduler step.
protocol.scheduler: Require last_epoch303000, base_lrs matching configured lr and last/optimizer lr matching the original schedule at303000. Preserve remaining scheduler structure and require expected step-count advancement relative to immutable input.
protocol.metrics: Require complete newline-delimited JSON, finite required training and validation fields, exactly one training row every500 steps through303000, and one validation row every20000 steps plus303000. Reject duplicate/gapped rows and verify resumed row LR against original schedule. Pre-resume history must match immutable input rows through the input step; input rows beyond checkpoint are historical discarded work.
protocol.verification: CPU positive structural fixture plus faults: unfinished step, inference-only marker, config mismatch, model/full mismatch, nonfinite state, missing optimizer state, wrong moment shape, wrong counter, scheduler mismatch, invalid RNG shape, missing/duplicate/nonfinite metric rows. Check CLI refuses a currently live A014 run before creating audit outputs or GPU state. These tests cannot pass a scientific run.
protocol.review: Actual completed-run audit gets its own result and post-result literature review. The corresponding A014 continuation result then binds to that audit before its final review can pass. Never substitute software/startup reviews for final completion. A003 remains required after all six final operational reviews.

success: Software rejects declared faults and actual terminal artifacts satisfy all original-state checks. Any real missing/mismatched state is technical_blocked with evidence retained; numerical/performance success remains separate.
stop: Refuse live/nonzero/unfinished runs, changed lineage, malformed states/metrics or any GPU initialization. Preserve failures and review before any successor. Do not regenerate a missing artifact or alter training to make validation pass.
